messages:
Maya: opened a PR for audit export retention + migration guidance — added a Ruby SDK example and a compact migration checklist. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4567
Maya: main change: clarify default 90d retention, tenant override behavior, and show export.v2 field mappings from export.v1
Joel: nice. can you paste the ruby snippet here so i can eyeball param names?
Maya: ```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.audit_exports.create(tenant_id: 'acct_123', format: 'export.v2', retention_days: 90)
puts resp.download_url
```
Joel: looks ok but our v2 SDK naming usually uses `export_format` instead of `format` — iirc other examples use that
Erin: +1 on aligning param names to the rest of the SDK surface. if we change param name we should update the migration table too
Samir: also add a short note mapping `kv_fields` and `meta` between v1/v2 so integrators know how to update downstream parsers
legal-ops: quick legal check — please avoid absolutist language like "we never store" in public docs. prefer "we do not retain customer plaintext beyond configured retention windows" or similar
Maya: yep updated the wording in the PR to: "Redwood does not retain customer plaintext outside of configured retention windows; audit exports obey tenant retention and export policies." PTAL
docs-bot: @Maya CI checks passed, preview published: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/audit-exports/migration-v2.html :white_check_mark:
Chris: small nit — the curl example in the PR still had `--insecure` from a dev test, pls remove before merge
Maya: removed the `--insecure` flag and added a one-line migration checklist at the top of the doc (what to change in code, what to watch for in logs)
Maya: also added a short ruby snippet variant showing `export_format` renamed, so both readers who use v1 names and the new canonical name see examples
Erin: I'll review the naming diff now, aim to get in within 2h
Samir: fyi i'll draft a single-line release note for Security > Audit logs once the PR is merged
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup: any other blockers?
Joel: none from me after the param rename is applied
legal-ops: approved the wording change, no further comments
Maya: good to merge once erin approves and CI stays green
